# Coordinated re-gate checkpoints for brainstorming #42 These are narrated prescribed actions, not live calls. Each checkpoint (A-F) is independent and continues from the shared admission prefix below. **Gap note.** The bundled re-gate references do not define the following: - companion provisioning on a marked re-gate - a live `ls-remote` existence check - contract-drift stops - base-sync merge recovery - companion rewrites on re-gate Where a checkpoint below uses one of these, it is marked **[case-fixed]**. Its stop wording is modeled on the nearest bundled stop. All other stop text is bundled grammar filled in with the observed values. ## Command legend | Id | Command → observation | |---|---| | V | `gh pr view 42 --json number,url,state,isDraft,title,body,headRefName,headRefOid,headRepository,isCrossRepository,baseRefName` → OPEN, in-repo, head `spec-export`, base `main` | | C1 | `git -C /work/widget fetch origin main spec-export`; `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main` → `5555…5555` | | C2 | `git -C /work/widget diff --name-status 5555…5555...1111…1111` → `A doc/specs/export.md` only | | C3 | `git -C /work/widget show 1111…1111:doc/specs/export.md` → `**Engine:** deferred` before the first `##` | | O | `git -C /work/widget show 5555…5555:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md` → the sibling declarations | | G(p) | `git -C

config --get remote.origin.url` | | P(r) | `git -C show-ref --verify refs/heads/spec-export`; `git -C worktree list --porcelain`; test whether the resolved home exists | | L(r) | **[case-fixed]** `git -C ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export` | | H | pr-head stops (see below), then add, verify, record ref, and merge-sync (see below) | H stops, in order: 1. `git -C fetch origin` 2. `git -C rev-parse --verify -q ^{commit}` 3. `origin/spec-export == ` 4. no other checkout of `spec-export` 5. local-branch ancestry H add, verify, record ref, and merge-sync: - `git -C worktree add /.worktrees/spec-export spec-export` (DWIM existing-branch checkout) - `git -C rev-parse HEAD == ` - `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export update-ref refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-42 1111…1111` (home only) - `git -C merge --no-ff --no-edit origin/main` - `git -C merge-base --is-ancestor HEAD` Shared prefix for every checkpoint: - Run V. - Derive ROOT from the common dir (submodule guard: none). - Run C1-C3. The predicate passes and the marker is present, so the route is re-gate with forced `SYNC=merge`. - Binding, context-builder, and thread queries are skipped. The failing thread query is never attempted. ## A - Two legs 1. **Block count.** C3's `## Legs` holds 2 blocks, before home provisioning: `acme/widget`, then `acme/helper`. 2. **Home provisioning.** - Run H on `/work/widget`; all stops pass. - The recorded `create:` contains `-b`, so the built-in checkout runs. The `-B` variant behaves identically. - The clean merge records `merge: `. Home report: ``` Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export Branch: spec-export Base: spec-export @ 1111111 PR: acme/widget#42 Pre-rework head: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111 Base SHA: 5555555 create: override skipped (contains -b) ``` 3. **Settle membership.** - Run O. `acme/helper` matches the first declaration, so only helper is probed. - G(/work/helper) returns `acme/helper`, which is not home. 4. **Companion preflight, all companions before any add.** - Run P(/work/helper): no local branch, no listed tree, no path. - **[case-fixed]** L(/work/helper) exits 0. 5. **Companion provisioning.** Run H on `/work/helper` with head `2222…2222` and the same `-b` skip. No pre-rework ref is written for helper. 6. **Inventory, home first:** ``` Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` 7. **Gate.** - Pin the audit with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export log -1 --diff-filter=A --format=%H -- doc/specs/export.md`, which returns `6666…6666`. - `git -C … show -s --format=%b 6666…6666` shows all three labels, so row 3 is enabled. - Mint a fresh `SUMMARY_PATH` and dispatch the `spec-summarizer`. The `Read` of the summary is the last content-producing call before the gate. - The initial spec commit is skipped. - Clean up with `rm "$SUMMARY_PATH"`. ``` gauntlet: gate=brainstorming/user-review-gate Retried exports retain receipts. Spec written and committed to widget/doc/specs/export.md (worktree: /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export). Scope cuts: none Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected 1 … 2 … 3 … 4 … 5 … (bundled rows verbatim) Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists ``` ## B - Three legs, codec's remote branch deleted - Block count is 3. - Home is provisioned as in A. - O and G pass for both helper and codec. - P passes for both. - L(/work/helper) exits 0. - **[case-fixed]** L(/work/codec) exits 2 with no output. The branch is absent; the stale `origin/spec-export` ref (`3333333`) after the plain fetch proves nothing. Stop, before any companion add, local-ref update, or merge: ``` acme/codec: origin has no refs/heads/spec-export (ls-remote exit 2; stale origin/spec-export at 3333333 ignored); push spec-export with its leg file and rerun brainstorming #42. Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export ``` **Independent: lookup failure.** L exits 128. This is a transport error, not absence: ``` acme/codec: origin lookup failed (exit 128): fatal: unable to access origin; rerun brainstorming #42 once origin is reachable. ``` The same preserved-legs list follows. **Recovery on the originating machine.** 1. `git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md` returns `7777…7777`. 2. `git -C /work/codec push -u origin spec-export` pushes from the ref. The primary stays on `main` with no checkout. 3. Rerun brainstorming #42. Codec then provisions normally; it is never declared incomplete. **Independent: commit missing everywhere.** The `log` returns nothing. Stop: ``` acme/codec: leg file doc/specs/export.md exists on no spec-export ref; the coordinated spec is incomplete - nothing regenerated. ``` ## C - Codec not declared at BASE_SHA - O, read at `5555…5555`, lists only helper. The worktree copy's codec line is not authority. - **[case-fixed]** Stop: ``` ### Leg: acme/codec matches no - sibling: declaration in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md at 5555555; declare it on main and rerun brainstorming #42. ``` - No companion write occurs, and home is preserved. **Independent: helper validation.** This is the bundled legs rule: validate every declaration before any tree. Stop naming the line: ``` - sibling: https://github.com/acme/helper.git - ``` **Independent: codec PATH missing (last selected checkout).** The same validation stop applies. Helper is not created or synced either. ## D - Contract drift and malformed blocks **[case-fixed]** The recorded `contract:` is authoritative and is never chosen silently. Home drift: ``` acme/helper contract drift: recorded home: .worktrees/ -> /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export; resolved home: trees/ -> /work/helper/trees/spec-export. Amend the recorded contract or restore the setting, then rerun brainstorming #42. ``` Create drift (independent): ``` acme/helper contract drift: recorded create: git worktree add -b ; resolved create: workspace add . Amend the recorded contract or restore the setting, then rerun. ``` In both cases nothing is provisioned for helper. Contract repair is one amendment: 1. Edit the home `## Legs` helper block. 2. Commit with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export`. 3. Rewrite helper's `doc/specs/export.md` `### Leg: acme/helper` block, and commit with `git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. The amendment is never complete with only one of these commits. **Independent: malformed third block.** Stop: ``` ## Legs block 3 lacks ; home preserved at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export. ``` ## E - Partial provisioning 1. Home's base merge `8888…8888` succeeds, and helper reports ready. 2. Codec P lists `spec-export` at `/work/host/spec-export`. Stop: ``` branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first. Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` No leg is removed. **Rerun of home (bundled-gap note).** The bundled N=1 ancestry row and the `--ff-only` row would stop here. **[case-fixed]** recovery instead: - The local tip `8888…8888` is a two-parent merge. - `git -C /work/widget merge-base --is-ancestor 1111…1111 8888…8888` passes, and so does the same check for the second parent against `origin/main`. - The tree is clean, so the tree is reused unchanged: ``` Base sync recovered: 8888888 merge: no-op - head contains origin/main ``` - No reset and no `update-ref` are run. **Independent: helper merge unresolved.** - The helper's work fails, and `git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export merge --abort` exits 0 with a clean tree. - Stop: ``` base merge unresolved for acme/helper (doc/specs/old.md) - merge origin/main by hand in /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export and rerun brainstorming #42 Preserved created legs: acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export ``` - No gate is rendered. - The user's merge produces `9999…9999`; it is two-parent, with `2222…2222` and the second parent proven ancestors. - The rerun reuses the tree with `Base sync recovered: 9999999` and no reset. **Alternative: helper tip `aaaa…aaaa`, an ordinary commit.** Stop, never reset: ``` worktree /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export on spec-export carries commits beyond acme/helper's head (2222222) that are not base-sync merges; resolve by hand or remove the worktree. ``` **Race.** - Preflight passes and helper is provisioned. - Codec's H then runs a plain `fetch origin`, after which stale `origin/spec-export` still resolves to `3333333`. - **[case-fixed]** The repeated L(/work/codec) exits 2. The backstop stops with B's absence text before any codec write, listing home and helper as preserved. - Exit 128 instead produces B's lookup-failure text. ## F - Gate actions (from A) **Approval `1`.** 1. Decode: no grant, no funding. 2. Edit the home spec: ``` **Amend-grant:** none **Engine:** waves **PR:** acme/widget#42 ``` 3. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export add -- doc/specs/export.md` 4. Make a new commit `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`; never `--amend`. 5. Verify all three fields with `git -C … show HEAD:doc/specs/export.md`. 6. Leave companion files untouched. 7. Call `phase_tracker({ action: "complete", phase: "brainstorm" })`, then `/skill:writing-plans`. **Independent: change request "Keep receipts with pending status".** 1. Revise the home shared Design, then stage it and make a new commit without the old audit body. 2. **[case-fixed]** Rewrite `## Decisions` in helper's `doc/specs/export.md` and commit it via `git -C /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export`. This happens before the summarizer runs. 3. Mint a fresh temp path, dispatch the summarizer, and re-present the gate. 4. Council stays counted from the pinned `6666…6666` audit. No second council runs and no approval is inferred. Unchanged throughout: - audit pinning and grant decoding - no companion `**PR:**` fields - no pre-rework refs beyond `pr-42` - empty MEMBER_HEADS - no thread fetch - no handoff or resume route

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
**Narration only:** no calls are executed. The supplied references do not define several requested coordinated re-gate stop templates. Those are identified below as **reports**, not invented canonical wording. Checkpoint E also conflicts with the supplied PR-head recovery rules; its prescribed stop is shown explicitly.

### Shared command legend

1. **Required resource reads:** load `brainstorming/reference/pr-subject.md`, `spec-pr.md`, `legs.md`, `using-git-worktrees/reference/pr-head.md`, and their required references through `read` at their absolute skill paths. These are narrated prerequisites—not claims that bundled text was read into session context. Any unreadable required reference blocks the affected trace.
2. **Authoritative observations:** inspect the original-head spec with `git show 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111:doc/specs/export.md`; inspect governing home overrides at `BASE_SHA`, not from the synced worktree.
3. **Companion validation:** resolve selected declarations using the required shared parser; validate every selected primary, canonical path, and stored origin before creating any companion.
4. **Live branch check:** a successful plain fetch and a surviving remote-tracking ref do not establish that the remote branch still exists. The requested live check is:
   ```text
   git -C <primary> ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin refs/heads/spec-export
   ```
5. **Ready inventory:** retain verified locations home first. Never remove previously created trees after a later failure.

## A — Two legs

1. Narrate ordered admission: acme/widget#42 is OPEN, non-fork, and targets `main`.
2. Read the original-head diff and spec. Observe exactly one added spec, the deferred header marker before the first `##`, and **two** leg blocks: acme/widget, then acme/helper. Classify before home provisioning.
3. Read the required supersession-shape reference and apply the shape predicate. Force merge provisioning. Skip ticket binding, gathering, questionary, lint, council, and thread queries.
4. Provision the home existing branch using DWIM:
   ```text
   git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export spec-export
   ```
   Its configured creator contains `-b`, so do not execute that creator. Report:
   ```text
   create: override skipped (contains -b)
   Worktree ready at /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   Base: spec-export @ 1111111
   PR: acme/widget#42
   Pre-rework head: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
   Base SHA: 5555555
   ```
   Record the observed clean base-merge outcome.
5. Read authoritative home declarations and helper’s own overrides/settings. Validate helper’s identity, path, branch availability, and recorded contract before companion creation. Do not select codec merely because it is declared.
6. Provision helper through existing-branch DWIM, skipping its `-b` creator. Cleanly merge its base and verify readiness:
   ```text
   Worktree ready at /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   Branch: spec-export
   ```
7. **Independent `-B` delta:** likewise skip the creator and use existing-branch provisioning; do not execute a branch-recreating wrapper. The supplied reference’s literal skip-report spelling remains `create: override skipped (contains -b)`.
8. Pin audit commit `6666666666666666666666666666666666666666`. Its three labels enable option 3; counts are zero.
9. Dispatch the spec-only summarizer to a fresh absolute temporary file. After the required final read, render its observed summary verbatim: “Retried exports retain receipts.”
10. Present the gate with the home/helper inventory, AC 1 verbatim, `Scope cuts: none`, and:
    ```text
    Council: 0 applied, 0 deferred, 0 rejected
    Withheld: draft PR - #42 already exists
    ```
    Offer 1/2/3/4/5, not 6. Carry `preserve receipts` as command intent. No initial re-gate spec commit is required.

## B — Three legs; deleted codec remote

1. Read and count all three original-head blocks. Provision home, then settle and preflight **all** selected companions before adding either companion.
2. Observe codec’s plain fetch succeeds and its stale tracking ref still resolves to `3333333333333333333333333333333333333333`.
3. Perform the requested exact live lookup. Exit 2 with no output means **branch absence**, not successful availability.
4. **Report:** codec’s remote `refs/heads/spec-export` is absent; stop before every companion add, local-ref update, or merge. Preserve home. The bundled references provide no exact coordinated-absence stop string.
5. **Independent transport branch:** exit 128 with:
   ```text
   fatal: unable to access origin
   ```
   Report lookup failure, not branch absence; preserve home and stop at the same write boundary.
6. **Originating-machine recovery:** while `/work/codec` remains on `main`, inspect:
   ```text
   git -C /work/codec log -1 --format=%H refs/heads/spec-export -- doc/specs/export.md
   ```
   Observe `7777777777777777777777777777777777777777`. The operator can push `spec-export` and rerun admission/preflight. Do not check out the primary or regenerate its leg file.
7. **Independent missing-everywhere branch:** no retained leg-file commit exists. Report the handoff incomplete and stop; regenerate nothing.

## C — Missing declaration or invalid primary

1. Read the home overrides at `5555555555555555555555555555555555555555`.
2. Observe codec has no declaration there. A declaration in the home worktree cannot replace the authoritative base observation.
3. **Report:** selected leg acme/codec has no matching authoritative sibling declaration. Stop before companion writes. No exact unmatched-leg template is supplied.
4. **Independent validation branches:** helper’s missing `/work/helper`, stored origin acme/other, or canonical path equal to `/work/widget` each stops declaration validation, naming the offending declaration and observation.
5. If the last selected checkout is missing, neither helper nor codec is created or synced. Preserve home.

## D — Contract drift and malformed blocks

1. Read helper’s current overrides/settings and compare their resolved contract with the original-head recorded block.
2. **Home-path drift report:**
   ```text
   acme/helper contract mismatch:
   recorded home: .worktrees/<name>
   resolved home: trees/<name>
   ```
   Stop; choose neither silently.
3. **Independent creator-drift report:**
   ```text
   acme/helper contract mismatch:
   recorded create: git worktree add <home> -b <branch>
   resolved create: workspace add <home> <branch>
   ```
   Stop before provisioning.
4. A contract repair must update the home block and affected companion artifact consistently, committing home first and the companion through its own checkout. Do not declare repair complete while they disagree.
5. **Independent malformed-third-block branches:** missing repo identity, branch, or contract stops validation, naming block 3 and the missing field. Preserve home; do not provision malformed membership.

## E — Partial provisioning and recovery limits

1. Observe home’s successful base merge `8888888888888888888888888888888888888888`, then helper readiness.
2. Codec’s branch is already checked out elsewhere. Apply the prescribed stop:
   ```text
   branch spec-export is checked out at /work/host/spec-export; finish or remove that worktree first.
   ```
3. Report:
   ```text
   Preserved created legs:
   acme/widget spec-export /work/widget/.worktrees/spec-export
   acme/helper spec-export /work/helper/.worktrees/spec-export
   ```
   Remove nothing.
4. **Requested home recovery conflicts with the bundled rules.** For N=1 without a rework-base ref, PR-head explicitly retains its local-ancestry stop; its recognized merge recovery concerns admitted member merges, not a base-sync merge. Therefore the prescribed rerun stop is:
   ```text
   local branch spec-export is at 8888888, not an ancestor of origin/spec-export (1111111); rework needs the PR head.
   ```
   Do not invent `Base sync recovered: 8888888`, reset, or update the branch.
5. **Independent helper unresolved merge:** preserve the tree after the failed helper/abort checks and report unresolved `doc/specs/old.md`, requiring manual recovery. No companion-specific exact by-hand template is supplied.
6. A later manual merge `9999999999999999999999999999999999999999` likewise cannot be declared recoverable under an unstated base-sync recovery rule.
7. An unrelated helper tip `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa` must stop; never reset it.
8. **Codec race branch:** repeat the live lookup immediately before codec writes. Exit 2 reports absence and preserves home/helper; exit 128 with the fatal transport error reports lookup failure instead. Neither permits codec writes.

## F — Gate actions from A

1. On clean approval **1**, read the standing-grant rules and decode the reply. Commit, rather than amend published history:
   ```text
   **Amend-grant:** none
   **Engine:** waves
   **PR:** acme/widget#42
   ```
   Use subject `spec: select engine and grant for PR #42`; verify all three fields from committed home content. Companion files remain untouched.
2. **Independent change request:** revise shared Design to “Keep receipts with pending status”; rewrite the live helper artifact consistently and commit both repositories’ affected artifacts before re-gating.
3. Generate a fresh summary and re-present the gate. Infer no approval; run no second council.
4. Preserve ordinary audit pinning and grant decoding. Add no companion PR metadata, pre-rework refs, member-head entries, thread fetches, or handoff/resume route.
